preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n - 1 roads provided in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].
The graph formed by the roads (ignoring direction) is connected and has no cycles, forming a tree structure.

postconditions.expression: min_inversions == min(cost(root) for root in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The first line of output is the minimum number of road inversions required to make any city a valid capital, where cost(r) is the number of edges that must be reversed to make r the root of an arborescence.

postconditions.expression: sorted_capitals == sorted([r for r in range(1, n + 1) if cost(r) == min_inversions])
postconditions.description: The second line of output contains all cities that achieve the minimum inversion count, sorted in increasing order.
At least one valid capital exists.
